description_en: Retrieves the health status information of endpoint groups and endpoints under a specified listener
description_zh: 调用GetHealthStatus接口获取指定监听下终端节点组和终端节点的健康状态信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-health-status --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --listener-id lsr-bp1bpn0kn908w4nbw0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHealthStatus

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域ID，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: sends a dry run request and does not retrieve the health status of the listener. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format, and service limits. If the request fails the check, an error is returned. If the request passes the check, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the check, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the health status of the listener is retrieved
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求，取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会获取监听实例的健康状态信息。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并获取监听实例的健康状态信息
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Alibaba Cloud Global Accelerator (GA)

parameters.name: listener_id
